observation: Page title is a brand name plus tagline: 'Natural Wellbeing | All-Natural Supplements For Women Like You'. The page has lang=en, three meta tags (charset, viewport, description) and no JSON-LD.
The type system uses one family throughout: Helvetica Neue with Helvetica/Arial fallbacks. It appears on all 286 counted elements, and there is no separate display or serif face.
The hero h1 is 67.2px at weight 300, centered, in dark slate. 'For Women' is light and 'Like You' is bold teal, so one heading mixes two weights and colors across a line break.

The page has 87 anchors for only 3 buttons. Most interaction is link-based, including the product cards, nav and footer.
Landmark structure is clean: one header, one nav, one main, seven sections and one footer. There is exactly one h1. There are no article, aside or figure elements.

The heading hierarchy is irregular. The first headings in DOM order are five h3s (the menu categories) before the h1. 20 h3 elements outnumber the 5 h2s, and product names are h3s directly under the Best Sellers h2.

observation: The markup is lightly classed and not utility-based: 77 class attributes with 30 unique values, and 0 tailwind-like fraction. Only 2 inline style attributes are used. Layout uses 21 flex and 4 grid containers.
evidence: classes total 77, unique 30, tailwind_like_fraction 0; inline_style_attrs 2; display_flex 21, display_grid 4

observation: Border radii are mostly 0 (244 elements), with a smaller set at 1–7px (16), 8–15px (19) and pill (7). Sharp edges are the default and rounding is reserved for cards, inputs and buttons. The Menu toggle button has a 6px radius and 6px 12px padding with a transparent background.

Body text is 16px with a 25.6px line height (1.6). The section h2s are 35.2px at normal weight 400, and the 'Life is best traveled…' heading looks similar in size. Large headings use light-to-regular weights while card titles and buttons use bold.
The text colors form a tonal gray-teal scale: dark slate for headings, a mid gray-teal for paragraphs, a pale gray for footer text, and deep teal for prices and links. Each is a tint of the same hue.

Aria usage is minimal, with 5 attributes on the page. Images all have an alt attribute (alt_missing 0), but the decorative icons use empty alt. The 3 buttons include the Menu toggle, which suggests a collapsible nav for narrower widths.

The page is 1440px wide and 3857px tall, laid out as a single centered scroll with symmetric alignment. Headings, paragraphs and CTAs are center-aligned, and only the nav, footer columns and product-card text are left-aligned.
The page is image-light and text-heavy. Besides the logo, the category icons and the payment badges, no photography appears in the rendered screenshot. A supplements store shows no product packshots.
